# laravelforge_server_php_max_execution_time (Data Source)

Fetches the PHP `max_execution_time` setting of a Laravel Forge server.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `organization` (String) Organization slug.
- `server_id` (Number) ID of the server.

### Read-Only

- `max_execution_time` (Number) PHP `max_execution_time` in seconds.
